prompt:
In the Time Series Analytics microservice (microservices/time-series-analytics): a UDF deployment package was uploaded and POST /config returned 200, but the container logs show no sign of the task running, and data sent to POST /input isn't producing any flagged output. Figure out why and fix it.

First reproduce the problem yourself: deploy a UDF package where the tick script's measurement name doesn't match the topic used in POST /input (a deliberately introduced mismatch), and confirm POST /input produces no visible effect. Then diagnose and fix or clearly explain the root cause, and confirm the fix works (points now reach the UDF and get flagged as expected).
assertions: The agent successfully reproduced the bug (measurement/topic mismatch) and confirmed POST /input had no visible effect before attempting a fix
The agent correctly diagnosed the root cause as a measurement-name/topic mismatch, not a fabricated or incorrect diagnosis
The diagnosis is backed by specific cited evidence (log lines, file/config comparison), not just an assertion of the cause
The agent verified the fix by re-testing and confirming points now reach the UDF and get flagged as expected
The agent did not misdiagnose this as requiring a source code bug fix in main.py/classifier_startup.py, since the root cause is a config/tick-script authoring mistake, not a service defect
